item.title: Hard-core support for Quebec separation at 15 per cent, poll suggests
item.description: The Angus Reid survey also suggests 50 per cent of Quebecers are prepared to vote to remain in Canada and a further 15 per cent are leaning toward that decision.

item.title: Québec solidaire proposes exception to its gender rule so man can run in Gouin riding
item.description: Reports suggest Montreal NDP MP Alexandre Boulerice is the candidate in question.

item.title: Laval man who killed his children testifies about tension in his marriage
item.description: Kamaljit Arora said he was lending a lot of money to his wife's relatives, till it reached "$80,000 including interest."

item.title: Salary demands by Quebec medical specialists 'not reasonable,' Legault says
item.description: The FMSQ, which represents 5,000 specialists, said its members are “exasperated” at the pace of the talks with Quebec.

item.title: Nick Suzuki scores late tying goal in Canada's OT quarterfinal win over Czechia
item.description: The Montreal Canadiens captain scored his second goal of the Milano Cortina Olympics with 3:27 left in the third period.

item.title: Cowan: Canadiens' Noah Dobson and his wife fall in love with Montreal
item.description: Newlyweds' highrise downtown condo has a spectacular view that includes the giant mural of Leonard Cohen on a Crescent St. building.

item.title: Another limited strike by STM maintenance workers likely in March
item.description: Union says negotiations with management appear to be stalled.

item.title: Marwah Rizqy will remain excluded from Quebec Liberal caucus
item.description: "I informed (Rizqy) that she would not be rejoining the caucus of the Liberal Party of Quebec because of the series of (legal) procedures underway," leader Charles Milliard says.

item.title: Todd: Habs' Nick Suzuki scores one for the ages to save Canada's bacon
item.description: Soft-spoken Canadiens captain steps up on world's biggest stage with crucial marker to help Team Canada reach Olympic semifinals

item.title: Laval's Steven Dubois races to gold in short-track speed skating at Milano Olympics
item.description: The speed skater's victory brings Canada's total gold medal count to four
